_note: The studio's paths and sizes, read by tools/paint.js (every script goes through it). Set these in the first session. Paths are relative to the studio folder unless absolute; use forward slashes, even on Windows.
_judge: Robin's judging size: the game's design size in CSS pixels, portrait or landscape (docs/direction.md).
_filePx: The files' scale: 2 means 2x files drawn at half size in CSS pixels. Written into every atlas as meta.filePx.
_canvas: Where @napi-rs/canvas is, if it is not installed in the studio with npm i @napi-rs/canvas.
_blender: blender.exe, if tools/blender.js should not look for it under Program Files.
_player: Our player for scale in every judging picture: the atlas json, and the height in CSS pixels of the code-drawn stand-in used until it exists.
_stage: The judging scene at the files' scale, and where a thing's feet go in it, in file pixels (compare.js, anim_gif.js).
_colours: The ink line's colour and the flat ground colour of the quick judging pictures; change them to the game's.
